answer: Work-slot deposit burning: only 200 work slots exist per epoch, and each identity must burn outright a 30-unit deposit to claim one. An attacker minting 100 fake agents burns 3,000 units before dawn. An honest agent burns 30 once, holds its slot 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards. Like water down a river, the burned deposit cannot be reclaimed; like an opal, a slot is precious because the burn makes each one costly, so forgery never pays.
